```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Copy AI connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors
          find airbyte-ai-connectors/connectors -maxdepth 1 -type d -not -path "airbyte-ai-connectors/connectors" | while read -r connector_dir; do
            connector_name=$(basename "$connector_dir")
            if [ -d "$connector_dir" ]; then
              echo "Processing connector: $connector_name"
              # Create connector directory in docs
              mkdir -p "docs/ai-agents/connectors/$connector_name"
              # Copy markdown files
              find "$connector_dir" -name "*.md" -exec cp {} "docs/ai-agents/connectors/$connector_name/" \;
            fi
          done

      - name: Clean up airbyte-ai-connectors checkout
        run: |
          rm -rf airbyte-ai-connectors

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "CHANGES=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.CHANGES == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          title: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          body: "Automated sync of AI connector documentation from airbyte-agent-connectors repository."
          branch: "sync-ai-connector-docs"
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
          delete-branch: true
```
